notes.title: Night Time Shoveling & Working on the Dialogue System
notes.notes:
In this update we show off the new dialogue system and what it's like to shovel in the late evening. There are plans to incorporate a full day/night and weather system, however the night time might just go up to almost dark to avoid pitch black. 

In this video you can see we're working on the conversations with the townsfolk of Windrow. This dialogue hints at the overall story to the game. ːsteamhappyː

[previewyoutube=djAotZoQsIM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We havent been updating the Steam page as much as I had hoped, although we do keep Twitter, Reddit and Youtube posts updated regularly. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Devlog: Fine Tuning the Snowblower Functionality in Push Comes to Shovel
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=iqJhHDvYAsc;full][/previewyoutube]

One of the snow removal tools you'll get to use in Push Comes to Shovel is a Snowblower. Each tool will have strengths and weaknesses. 

[b]Example[/b]

Small shovel - Quick but not very wide
Bucket shovel - Wider and a bit slower than a small shovel
Plow Push shovel - Extra wide but slower
Snowblower - Slow but accurate
Plow attachments of various sizes for various vehicles

notes.title: Devlog: Pedestrian AI & Traffic
notes.notes:
Working on adding pedestrians in Push Comes to Shovel. You will be able to interact with particular pedestrians who are requesting a job. Players can also lose money for upgrades if they run them over ːsteamsadː

[previewyoutube=hLTH-HB2Bqs;full][/previewyoutube]

Also working on integrating traffic which can affect your ability to finish plow jobs. With that said there could be less traffic until a particular road is plowed. I can't post a Youtube short here so here's the [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/toe0CWilgrs?feature=share]link to this video.[/url]
